lines.text: Wait! Can Holding 1 Sneeze Really Pop Your Eyes Out!
Most kids guess totally wrong about holding in a sneeze!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Strong eye muscles keep eyes safely locked in place, but.
blocking a powerful sneeze forces air pressure toward delicate eardrum tubes.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Don'T Hold It!
